dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear trailing edge with zero curvature; trailing margin is defined by a single straight geometric segment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with a zero-pixel radius at the intersection of the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 (maximum base width to maximum vertical height).

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: null (feature is composed of flat geometric planes; no measurable curvilinear radius present)
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, triangular projection with a thickness nearly equal to its visible length from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximately 155 degrees at the faceted intersection of the dorsal cranial plane and the rostrum surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-polygon 3D mesh rendering characterized by visible flat-shaded facets and a monochromatic cyan/teal texture map.
